senses.gloss: (v. גּוּס II; cmp. גִּיסָא III) to recline, to dine.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 3:8:8">Y. Snh. III, 21ᶜ</cite> top <he>אשגח למֵיגוֹס גו וכ׳</he> cared to remain undisturbed at a banquet among the guests.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:13">Esth. R. to I, 8</cite> <he>דבעי מֵיגַס וכ׳</he> where one wants first to dine and then to drink.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28">Lev. R. s. 28</cite> why dost thou not allow the guests <he>דיִגְסוּן</he> to eat? <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 2:17">Koh. R. to II, 17</cite>; a. fr.—Denom. <cite ref="M00162"><he>מַגָּס</he></cite>, <cite ref="M00167"><he>מְגִיסְתָּא</he></cite> &c.
